correctness.rationale: Petersen Laplacian eigenvalues 0,2^5,5^4 give 2000 spanning trees by matrix-tree. Every omitted edge has a unique fundamental path; two and only two pivot choices remove the path endpoints adjacent to the new chord, giving degree 12. An independently written graph builder enumerated exactly all 5005 nine-edge candidates, confirmed 2000 acyclic connected trees, built each legal incident-edge exchange, verified 12 regular neighbors, ran BFS for each of the 2000 sources and counted unordered pair distances [12000,72000,266940,588060,678350,327080,52500,2070] and pivot-vs-basis-exchange excess [565010,1045740,363290,24810,150]. Independent natural 120-element S5 group action gives 21 tree orbits and 2 extreme-pair orbits [30,120] with 60 endpoints. Finite exhaustive census proves exact natural invariant; no assertion about all cubic graphs or Hamiltonicity.
